<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="robots" content="index, follow" />

  <title>Historical Hurricane Tracks</title>
  <meta name="description"
    content="NOAA Hurricane Tracks, NOAA Historical Hurricane Tracks, hurricane paths, hurricane history, hurricane database" />

  <!-- Preload fonts -->

  <link rel="preload" href="./PublicSans-Black-KvmPAHZw.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>

  <!-- Preload icon library -->
  <!-- NOTE: Vite doesn't forgive older scripts from assigning variables that aren't declared like Parcel did.
    The icons.js file below does just that, and will throw an error if the variable isn't declared. A global
    was being created during the build of the pre-vite production build, with Vite it must be done manually. -->
  <script>
    window.prefixesArray = [];
    window.prefixesSelectorString = "";
  </script>

  <!-- Google Analytics -->
  <script src="//coast.noaa.gov/js/federated-analytics.js"></script>
  <script type="module" crossorigin src="./index-C0m842ie.js"></script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" crossorigin href="./index-BxyISYtg.css">

</body>
